label: Activity one
subgoals: Set the activity factor of a clock to one
Multiply capacitance, supply squared and frequency
Read pF times V squared times GHz as mW

label: Where the capacitance lives
subgoals: Add wire capacitance from length and capacitance per length
Add the pin and buffer capacitance
Apply the clock power formula to the total

label: The clock's share of total power
section: The clock's share of total power
subgoals: Weight each capacitance by its activity factor
Cancel the common supply and frequency factor
Divide clock power by the total
